head: 72339ed

reviews.name: phase18-spec-review
reviews.note: Stale row frames (a filtered or closed workspace could take the drop), drags on a stopped session's rows, a tab over the rows not refused, a silent half-done re-place, no + highlight on a full track.

reviews.name: phase18-ponytail-review
reviews.note: Showed the synthesized-event fallback in DragSource.begin was dead (CI then proved it), and cut duplicated drag-state matching and DropTarget cases.

reviews.name: phase18-e2e-review
reviews.note: Read only (GUI paused). Saw the spring-load test passed without a spring-load; making the drop fail to prove it led to two herdr facts (a lone pane does not zoom; a move without target_pane_id splits the focused pane) and a real bug in capsule drops.

reviews.name: phase18-spec-review-2
reviews.note: Clean; highlight timings, one doc line, a Findings wording.

reviews.name: phase18-ponytail-review-2
reviews.note: Clean; moved the track-end state into the tab bar.

reviews.name: phase18-verifier
reviews.note: PASS on every Build and e2e item, citing CI; found a stale doc comment and a doc line claiming a forbidden pointer. Most of its 20 minutes was waiting for CI.

notes: The GUI was paused 20 minutes in (the user needed the laptop), so after one local single-test run (killed) every e2e run was CI's full suite (8 runs, 15-20 min each). The drag approach was proven on CI, and the rough screenshot came from a failed run's screen recording. Slowed by blind CI loops on the spring-load test: XCUITest runs nothing during a drag (no mid-drag checks), a lone pane does not zoom, and a move without target_pane_id splits the tab's focused pane (the design said its whole layout). A CI frame showed a .forbidden over the own capsule falling through to the track-end target behind it (fixed after the verifier). The scheme now keeps every test recording and CI uploads green runs, so screenshots come from CI. Hand checks are listed in Findings for the orchestrator.
